nodes.label: Placeholder Theme Preview Screenshot
nodes.rationale: The theme ships a deliberately minimal placeholder screenshot rather than a capture of the rendered front page: a near-white canvas (roughly 1200x900, the conventional WordPress theme-screenshot ratio) with only the theme name centred in blue monospace text. It satisfies WordPress's requirement that a theme directory contain screenshot.png for the Appearance > Themes preview, while avoiding a design capture that would go stale as the theme CSS changes and that would not render Sinhala branding correctly.

nodes.label: Nightly Backup + Off-Site Sync (Backblaze B2)
nodes.rationale: backup.sh dumps the database and archives wp-content nightly via cron, keeping 7 days locally, but a backup living only on the same VPS does not survive that VPS being lost, hacked or destroyed - the commented-out Backblaze B2 sync (a few cents per GB/month) is not optional for a site that is someone's income.

nodes.label: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME / Volume-Name Coupling with backup.sh
nodes.rationale: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=gampola-janamadyawediya in .env is what produces the Docker volume name gampola-janamadyawediya_wordpress_data that backup.sh hard-codes; changing it silently breaks backups, so it must be changed in both places or not at all.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Stack (Nginx, WordPress, MariaDB, Redis)
nodes.norm_label: docker compose stack (nginx, wordpress, mariadb, redis)

nodes.label: Local Development Compose Override
nodes.rationale: Auto-merged by Docker Compose when present in the same directory, so it must never exist on the server - the README's deployment steps delete it, otherwise production would serve the local config on port 8080.

nodes.label: Deploy Lint Job
nodes.rationale: PHP syntax check over theme, mu-plugins and tests, plus php tests/run.php smoke tests and docker compose config -q, runs before any deploy so a broken tree never reaches the server.

nodes.label: PR Quality and Security Checks Workflow
nodes.norm_label: pr quality and security checks workflow

nodes.label: TruffleHog Secret Scan Job
nodes.rationale: fetch-depth:0 because TruffleHog needs full history to scan every commit in the PR; --only-verified keeps the noise down to live credentials.

nodes.label: Code Map (theme = application source, .github = project configuration)
nodes.norm_label: code map (theme = application source, .github = project configuration)

nodes.label: Dependabot github-actions Ecosystem (weekly)
nodes.rationale: Weekly monitoring of the GitHub Actions used by the workflows; commit-message prefix chore(deps) keeps automated bumps distinguishable from feature commits.

nodes.label: !override YAML Tag Replacing the Production Port List
nodes.norm_label: !override yaml tag replacing the production port list
nodes.rationale: Compose merges port lists by appending, so !override replaces them entirely and the dev stack binds only 8080 instead of also opening 80/443 on the developer machine; volume mounts are keyed by container path so the local vhost mount replaces the prod one.

nodes.label: Skip Deploy When SSH Secrets Missing
nodes.norm_label: skip deploy when ssh secrets missing
nodes.rationale: Exits 0 with a warning when SSH_HOST/SSH_KEY are unset so CI stays green and readable before the server secrets exist; the warning points at CI_CD_PIPELINE.md section 7.

nodes.label: Production Deploy Concurrency Group
nodes.rationale: concurrency group production-deploy with cancel-in-progress:false lets the running deploy finish and queues the new one instead of killing a half-applied deployment.

nodes.label: Google AdSense Authorized Seller Record (pub-3501283147480868)
nodes.rationale: Declares google.com as a DIRECT authorized seller for this publisher ID with cert authority f08c47fec0942fa0, the public record AdSense buyers check before serving ads.

nodes.label: Google AdSense Monetization via Site Kit
nodes.norm_label: google adsense monetization via site kit
nodes.rationale: AdSense was required once the paywall was ruled out; Site Kit with Auto ads avoids manual ad-zone coding. Graphic-content articles will get restricted ad serving under Google's Shocking Content policy - low or no revenue on those specific posts is expected, not a bug, and revenue is carried by general content.

nodes.label: Censored-Teasers-to-Full-Article Workflow (blurred on Facebook, full on site)
nodes.norm_label: censored-teasers-to-full-article workflow (blurred on facebook, full on site)
nodes.rationale: Write the post with the real image, set a featured image (required for the auto-blur fallback), tick Graphic Content, then let the manual or automatic blurred social image carry the Facebook link preview. Routine safe posts stay Facebook-only from the mobile app; graphic posts are done on the laptop dashboard because the extra steps are fiddly on a phone.

nodes.label: content_flag Taxonomy (Graphic Content, Sensitive Topic)
nodes.rationale: Registered by the content-flag-taxonomy mu-plugin as a separate taxonomy with a Content Flags checkbox panel in the post editor sidebar; graphic-content triggers the full-screen gate plus blurred share image, sensitive-topic triggers only a dismissible banner with no blur.

nodes.label: Graphic Content Warning Gate (click-through, session memory)
nodes.norm_label: graphic content warning gate (click-through, session memory)
nodes.rationale: A full-screen click-through gate for graphic-flagged posts. The reader's I-understand decision is stored in sessionStorage, so reloads and back-navigation do not re-prompt, while closing and reopening the browser resets the gate. Gate text follows the site language (Sinhala under a Sinhala WP locale, English otherwise) and strings can be overridden by developers through the ncg_gate_texts filter.

nodes.label: Auto-Blur Social Share Image Fallback
nodes.rationale: When no manually censored social image is uploaded, this fallback generates a heavily blurred plus pixelated copy of the featured image and sets it as og:image. It deliberately overrides Rank Math/Yoast default output (which would use the real featured image) so that even a forgetful operator can never leak the raw graphic image into Facebook link previews.

nodes.label: Legal Pages Required Before AdSense Application
nodes.norm_label: legal pages required before adsense application

nodes.label: Three-Layer Taxonomy (categories, tags, content flags)
nodes.rationale: Each layer serves a different purpose and must not be mixed: Layer 1 categories are editorial sections powering the header menu, Layer 2 tags are cross-referencing entities powering related articles (2-5 per post, never a one-use tag), Layer 3 content flags are warning metadata not shown in navigation - so a fatal accident post is Category=Crime & Courts plus Flag=Graphic Content, not a choice between them.

nodes.label: redis Service (news_redis)
nodes.rationale: Runs as a plain LRU cache capped at 128mb with allkeys-lru eviction, which is what makes it safe as a WordPress object cache for a small VPS.

nodes.label: Healthcheck-Gated Startup Ordering
nodes.rationale: All four containers define healthchecks and depend on service_healthy conditions (MariaDB+Redis before WordPress, WordPress before Nginx) rather than plain start order, so a cold start waits 30-60 seconds instead of racing an unready database.

nodes.label: Local Dev Stack at localhost:8080 Without SSL
nodes.norm_label: local dev stack at localhost:8080 without ssl
nodes.rationale: Removes the need for SSL certs locally by serving HTTP on 8080 from nginx/local/local.conf and pointing WP_SITEURL/WP_HOME at http://localhost:8080.

nodes.label: WP_REDIS_HOST Wiring in WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA
nodes.rationale: The same WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA block also hardens the install (DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT), fixes filesystem writes through FS_METHOD=direct in the container, and disables WP-Cron in favour of external scheduling.

nodes.label: GeneratePress Parent + Gampola Janamadyawediya Child Theme
nodes.norm_label: generatepress parent + gampola janamadyawediya child theme
nodes.rationale: GeneratePress is one of the lightest themes available - every KB saved is bandwidth and load time on a modest self-hosted VPS - and renders Sinhala Unicode correctly out of the box. The child theme cannot activate until the parent is installed, otherwise WordPress silently falls back to a default theme.

nodes.label: Redis Object Cache Plugin
nodes.rationale: Activated from the plugin screen and auto-connects to the redis container through the WP_REDIS_HOST constant already set in docker-compose.yml; cuts database load during traffic spikes.

nodes.label: Convention: require with get_stylesheet_directory()
nodes.rationale: PHP includes must be pulled in with require(get_stylesheet_directory() . ...) rather than relative paths, and must keep their .php extensions, so includes resolve against the child theme directory regardless of the active parent theme.

nodes.label: Decision: Self-Hosted WordPress on a Docker VPS
nodes.norm_label: decision: self-hosted wordpress on a docker vps
nodes.rationale: Cheapest ongoing cost (~5-12 USD/mo), matches the maintainer's Linux/Docker background, and gives full control over the content-warning gate and image pipeline that managed hosts will not allow customising. A non-technical operator publishes from the WP mobile app while the maintainer owns the server. Do not go below 2 GB RAM; Linode Singapore/Mumbai for latency to Sri Lanka.

nodes.label: CF_ZONE_ID / CF_API_TOKEN Environment Wiring
nodes.rationale: Passed to the WordPress container for the cloudflare-purge mu-plugin, with empty-string defaults so the purge path no-ops gracefully in local dev and during initial setup.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Plugin Automatic Cache Purge on Publish
nodes.norm_label: cloudflare plugin automatic cache purge on publish
nodes.rationale: The official Cloudflare WordPress plugin purges the edge cache when a post is published or updated, so readers see the latest version without manual cache clearing; needs an API token and Automatic Cache Management enabled.

nodes.label: Crimson and Navy Split-Circle Palette
nodes.rationale: Inner circle is split vertically - navy on the left, crimson red on the right - with white/yellow type for contrast. The high-saturation red reads as breaking-news urgency while navy grounds it as authoritative; the split also gives the emblem a clear left/right division so the pen-and-eye mark stays legible at favicon size.

nodes.label: Editorial Section Ring (Local News, International News, Art and Culture, Sports, Cinema, Gossip, Education, Entertainment, Politics, Technology)
nodes.norm_label: editorial section ring (local news, international news, art and culture, sports, cinema, gossip, education, entertainment, politics, technology)
nodes.rationale: The middle navy ring enumerates the site's content categories on the logo itself, declaring the publication's coverage scope (hard news, culture, sport, entertainment, lifestyle) as part of the brand mark.

nodes.label: Eye, Camera-Aperture Iris and Fountain Pen Mark
nodes.norm_label: eye, camera-aperture iris and fountain pen mark
nodes.rationale: Composite emblem: a fountain pen forms the eyebrow of a large eye whose pupil is a camera iris/aperture. It fuses the two tools of the trade - written reporting and photojournalism - into one 'watchful' mark, reinforcing the watchdog/observation idea behind local news coverage.

nodes.label: Gampola Janamadyawediya (publication name)
nodes.rationale: Rendered twice in the outer red ring - Latin transliteration at top, Sinhala-Latin caps at bottom - so the identity carries the place name Gampola and the Sinhala-derived word janamadyawediya (media/journalist) for a local audience.

nodes.label: Ring Section Read as 'NOTION' (uncertain - possibly 'Motion' or a transposed label)
nodes.norm_label: ring section read as 'notion' (uncertain - possibly 'motion' or a transposed label)
nodes.rationale: One segment of the yellow category ring reads NOTION between GOSSIP and EDUCATION; the reading is uncertain at this resolution and may be a typo or a scanning artifact of the curved text. Flagged for human review.

nodes.label: Truth and Trust (tagline)
nodes.rationale: Placed directly under the word NEWS inside the inner circle: states the editorial values claim (truthfulness plus reader trust) that the publication positions itself on.

nodes.label: Gampola Janamadyawediya Logo (circular badge)
nodes.rationale: Circular seal/badge format chosen to read as an institutional masthead mark; three concentric rings let the publication name, its web address, and its full editorial scope coexist in one lockup without additional type.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Proxied DNS (CDN, DDoS, WAF)
nodes.rationale: Proxied (orange cloud) A records are what grant the free CDN, DDoS protection and WAF, and they hide the VPS's real IP - this matters for a site that may host controversial, graphic news content and draw hostile traffic.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Origin Certificate + Full (strict) SSL
nodes.rationale: Encrypts Cloudflare-to-VPS traffic without Let's Encrypt/Certbot renewal automation, since Origin certs last 15 years. Cert and key live at nginx/certs/cloudflare-origin.pem and .key; SSL mode must be Full (strict).

nodes.label: UptimeRobot HTTPS Monitoring
nodes.rationale: A 5-minute HTTPS monitor gives an email/SMS alert the moment the site is down instead of the operator hearing about it from an angry reader.

nodes.label: Security Hardening Checklist
nodes.rationale: Firewall limited to 22/80/443 plus fail2ban and unattended-upgrades from deploy.sh, Cloudflare proxy and Full (strict) as edge layers, xmlrpc.php blocked at Nginx, PHP execution blocked under /wp-content/uploads/, security headers set, and all 4 containers healthchecked. Still open: a tested off-site restore and 2FA on the WP admin account.

nodes.label: Decision: .com Domain (with .lk later)
nodes.rationale: Instant registration, no paperwork, globally trusted by AdSense and search engines; add a .lk and redirect if the operation formalises into a registered business. Bought through Cloudflare Registrar at wholesale (~9-10 USD/yr) or Namecheap.
